summary:
The needle was an off-by-one in the pagination offset in `app/app.py:28`:

```python
offset = (page - 1) * per_page - (1 if page > 1 else 0)
```

For any page after the first, it subtracted an extra 1 from the offset, so page 2 started at ID 10 instead of 11 — duplicating the last item of page 1 and shifting every subsequent page. I removed the spurious subtraction so the offset is just `(page - 1) * per_page`, and `test.sh` now passes: `PASS: Pagination is correct across page boundaries`.
